town_description: Korba is a major industrial city in Chhattisgarh, often called the power capital of the state, with large coal mines and thermal power plants (including NTPC and BALCO) around it. It lies on the banks of the Hasdeo river, which also shapes its religious geography, with riverbank shrines such as Sarvamangala and the Kanki temple nearby. The city is well connected by rail and road; the nearest airport is Swami Vivekananda Airport in Raipur.
